title: Per-design blockers, conditions and warnings
description: Each design's checks, built on risk-of-bias domains (RoB 2, ROBINS-I). A design takes its WORST state in the order Blocked > Conditional > Unknown > Feasible, so no answer can offset another. Tests are JSON Logic expressions evaluated over the answer store.

designs.description: Keyed by design id — must exist in spec/designs.csv, enforced by the build check.

jsonLogic.description: A JSON Logic expression over the answer store. Variables are answer ids; an unanswered id resolves to null, which must yield Unknown rather than false.

blockers.description: If any test is true the design is Blocked — it cannot be made to work with the answers given.

conditions.description: No blocker, but something required is unmet or unevidenced. Yields Conditional, with unlock text saying what would resolve it.

warnings.description: Listed alongside a Feasible verdict. Never changes the state. Numeric thresholds live here, with their range and source.

message.description: Shown to the user. States what is wrong, in plain English.

unlock.description: What would resolve this, e.g. 'if rollout order could be randomised: stepped-wedge, Tier 1'. Expected on conditions.

rob_domain.description: The risk-of-bias domain this check derives from.

citations.description: At least one. The build check fails if a key is missing from references.bib — every rule must be traceable to a source.

threshold.description: Where the literature gives a number. Most are conventions, so the range and its contested status are carried with it and shown to the user.

basis.description: 'convention' where it is a rule of thumb; 'derived' where the source computes it.
